policy.deadlineRule: Provider deadlines and product reminder buffers are separate. Unknown rules stay unknown.
policy.costRule: Minimum cost means the lowest fixed-price qualifying action currently supported by official evidence for this route. Taxes, roaming differences and usage outside the stated basis remain separate.
policy.confidenceRule: Confidence measures evidence completeness, not service quality or future availability.

giffgaff-uk.inactivity_window: Six months with no qualifying SIM use triggers inactivity deactivation.
giffgaff-uk.clock_start_or_reset: The clock runs from the most recent qualifying action listed by giffgaff.
qualifying_activity: Call, SMS or MMS to another number, excluding emergency, Member Services, 0800 and other free-rated numbers.
At least one mobile-data connection.
An Airtime Credit purchase or plan purchase.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Community/account activity is not SIM activity.
Emergency, Member Services, 0800 and other free-rated calls/texts are explicitly excluded.
Incoming SMS, account login and balance checks are not documented as clock-reset actions.
giffgaff-uk.lowest_cost_documented_action: Send one standard UK PAYG SMS to a non-free-rated UK number. Current official PAYG price: £0.10 per text.
giffgaff-uk.safest_documented_action: If you want the least ambiguous remote keep-alive action, buy Airtime Credit before the six-month deadline; giffgaff explicitly lists Airtime Credit purchase as qualifying. Current minimum credit purchase is £10.

minimum_expected_cost.note: Outside-UK SMS pricing varies, so £0.10 is not a universal roaming cost.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product reminder buffer aligned with giffgaff’s first inactivity warning, which is sent about one month before deactivation.

giffgaff-uk.grace_or_rescue_window: The SIM itself cannot be reactivated after inactivity deactivation. A PAC can be requested from giffgaff agents within 30 days after deactivation to port the number to another UK network.
giffgaff-uk.termination_and_recycling: At 30 days or more after deactivation, the number cannot be retrieved; giffgaff says it returns to the available-number pool and is recycled.

sources.label: giffgaff — inactivity deactivation and 30-day PAC rescue

reminder.anchor_help: Use the date of the most recent documented qualifying call/SMS/MMS, mobile-data connection, Airtime Credit purchase or plan purchase.
reminder.summary: Take a qualifying giffgaff keep-alive action
reminder.description: Complete a documented qualifying action before the six-month inactivity deadline. The calendar event is placed 30 days early as a product-side buffer.

lebara-uk.inactivity_window: After 90 days with no call, text or mobile-data use, service is temporarily barred. After a further 365 days with no usage or top-up/plan purchase, the SIM expires.
lebara-uk.clock_start_or_reset: The first 90-day clock is defined by the last documented call, text or data use. After temporary barring, adding credit or buying a plan restores service. The official help page does not explicitly say that a top-up made before day 90 by itself resets the initial usage clock.
qualifying_activity: Make a call.
Send a text.
Browse/use mobile data.
After temporary barring, add credit or buy a plan to resume service.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Incoming SMS is not listed as qualifying use.
Account login and balance checks are not listed as qualifying use.
A pre-bar top-up as a substitute for call/text/data activity is not explicit in the cited official help rule.
lebara-uk.lowest_cost_documented_action: Send one standard UK PAYG SMS while the line is active. Current official UK rate: £0.19 per text. Data is charged per KB and could cost less, but the official page does not document a minimum billable data session, so it is not used as the fixed-cost baseline.
lebara-uk.safest_documented_action: Before 90 days, complete a normal chargeable call, SMS or data session. If the SIM has already been temporarily barred, add credit or buy a plan through Lebara to restore service.

minimum_expected_cost.note: Roaming rates can differ by destination.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer only; Lebara’s provider deadline remains 90 days.

lebara-uk.grace_or_rescue_window: Temporary barring after 90 days is followed by a further 365-day recoverable inactivity period; adding credit or buying a plan can restore service during that period.
lebara-uk.termination_and_recycling: After the further 365-day period, Lebara says the SIM expires and a new SIM/number is required. The cited official page does not state the exact number-recycling timing.

sources.label: Lebara UK — SIM inactivity and expiry

reminder.anchor_label: Last call, text or mobile-data use date
reminder.anchor_help: Use the last documented usage date that starts Lebara’s initial 90-day inactivity clock. Do not substitute a pre-bar top-up unless Lebara documents it for your plan.
reminder.summary: Use the Lebara line before temporary barring
reminder.description: Complete a normal documented call, text or data session before the 90-day inactivity boundary. The calendar event is placed 14 days early as a product-side buffer.

tello-us.inactivity_window: This monthly-plan route is payment/service based, not usage based. A plan lasts 30 days. If the monthly plan ends and is not renewed, the number has a 12-day grace period before expiration.
tello-us.clock_start_or_reset: A plan purchase or successful renewal starts a new 30-day billing cycle. The 12-day number grace period starts after the monthly service stops.
qualifying_activity: Successful automatic plan renewal.
Manual plan renewal or purchase of a new plan before the number expires.
Port out during the post-service grace period if leaving Tello.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts, data use or account login do not replace the required paid-plan renewal for this route.
A failed payment does not count as renewal.
Tello PAYG has a different 3-month credit-expiry rule and is not the retention model used for this monthly-plan route.
tello-us.lowest_cost_documented_action: Renew the current documented $5 / 30-day base plan.
tello-us.safest_documented_action: Keep Autopay enabled with a valid payment method and optionally enable Tello’s 48-hour renewal notice; verify the renewal succeeds before the service end date.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the 30-day renewal boundary.

tello-us.grace_or_rescue_window: 12 days after an unrenewed monthly plan ends. Buy a new plan or begin port-out before the grace period ends.
tello-us.termination_and_recycling: Tello states there is no recovery after the phone number expires. The cited help page does not state the later recycling timetable.

sources.label: Tello — phone-number expiration and grace period

reminder.anchor_label: Last successful plan renewal or purchase date
reminder.anchor_help: Use the start date of the current 30-day paid-plan cycle, not the date you opened this tool.
reminder.description: Verify the paid plan renews successfully before the 30-day service boundary. The calendar event is placed 3 days early as a product-side buffer.

ultra-paygo-us.inactivity_window: PayGo service runs in 30-day cycles. If the wallet balance is below the $3 recurring-charge minimum at the cycle end, service is suspended.
ultra-paygo-us.clock_start_or_reset: Activation or successful $3 monthly renewal starts the next 30-day cycle. During suspension, adding enough credit to meet the $3 minimum renews service for the next cycle.
qualifying_activity: Maintain at least $3 in the PayGo wallet for the recurring 30-day charge.
Add credit during suspension so the balance reaches the $3 renewal minimum.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts and data usage do not substitute for the $3 renewal charge.
A positive balance below $3 does not restore active service.
Voice/Text or Data Passes do not work on suspended or cancelled accounts.
ultra-paygo-us.lowest_cost_documented_action: Fund the recurring $3 PayGo service charge for each 30-day cycle. If new wallet funding is needed, Ultra’s documented Auto Renew denominations begin at $5, with $3 applied to the monthly renewal.
ultra-paygo-us.safest_documented_action: Enable Auto Renew with a valid card and enough wallet balance so the $3 recurring charge succeeds each cycle; do not rely on the suspension window.

minimum_expected_cost.note: A fresh Auto Renew top-up denomination may be $5 or more; unused wallet value remains separate from the $3 service charge.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the 30-day renewal boundary.

ultra-paygo-us.grace_or_rescue_window: Up to 60 days suspended. If balance is above $0 but below $3 after 60 days, the detailed terms provide an additional 30-day extension. If balance is $0 after 60 days, the account is cancelled without that extension.
ultra-paygo-us.termination_and_recycling: Ultra says the account and phone number are cancelled when the applicable grace path ends. The cited terms do not state the exact number-recycling timetable.

reminder.anchor_label: Last successful PayGo activation or renewal date
reminder.anchor_help: Use the start date of the current 30-day PayGo service cycle.
reminder.description: Make sure the PayGo wallet can cover the recurring $3 charge before the 30-day renewal boundary. The calendar event is placed 3 days early as a product-side buffer.

h2o-paygo-us.inactivity_window: The current $10 and $30 Pay As You Go refills expire after 90 days; the $100 refill expires after 365 days. If account balance remains $0 for 30 consecutive days, the account and phone number are cancelled.
h2o-paygo-us.clock_start_or_reset: The refill expiration clock starts from the purchased refill/renewal. Recharging before expiration preserves eligibility; the official page says remaining balance rolls over when the same amount is recharged before expiration.
qualifying_activity: Recharge the Pay As You Go plan before its stated expiration date.
Use AutoPay where offered to renew the selected refill before expiry.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts and data consume balance but are not documented as extending the refill expiration date.
Account login or incoming service does not replace the refill requirement.
Do not treat the 30-day $0-balance period as a normal retention strategy.
h2o-paygo-us.lowest_cost_documented_action: Renew the $10 / 90-day Pay As You Go refill. The current official plan page shows $9 with AutoPay.
h2o-paygo-us.safest_documented_action: Recharge the same Pay As You Go amount before its expiration date and verify the balance/plan renewed; keep the account away from a $0 balance.

minimum_expected_cost.basis: current $10 PayGo refill with advertised 10% AutoPay discount
minimum_expected_cost.note: Without AutoPay, the documented refill is $10; taxes/fees may apply.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the selected refill expiration date.

h2o-paygo-us.grace_or_rescue_window: If the balance is $0, cancellation occurs after 30 consecutive days at $0. Restore funded service before that point.
h2o-paygo-us.termination_and_recycling: After 30 consecutive days at $0, H2O says the account and phone number are cancelled. The cited terms do not state the exact number-recycling timetable.

sources.label: H2O Wireless — Pay As You Go refill prices and expiry
H2O Wireless — Pay As You Go terms

reminder.anchor_help: Enter the expiration date shown for your current PayGo refill. Current $10/$30 refills are 90 days and the $100 refill is 365 days, so using the actual expiration date avoids assuming the wrong refill cycle.
reminder.summary: Recharge H2O PayGo before refill expiry
reminder.description: Recharge before the current refill expires and keep the account away from a $0 balance. The calendar event is placed 7 days before the expiration date you enter.

mobal-japan-voice-data.inactivity_window: This Voice+Data 5G route is an ongoing monthly service, not an inactivity-based prepaid line. Long-term plan fees renew by calendar month until manually terminated.
mobal-japan-voice-data.clock_start_or_reset: For long-term plans, Mobal posts the invoice on the 1st and automatically charges the stored payment method on the 8th. Keeping the monthly service paid maintains the route.
qualifying_activity: Successful monthly plan payment.
Keep billing information valid so automatic payment succeeds.
Port the number before termination if moving to another eligible Japanese provider.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Incoming SMS or ordinary usage does not replace the monthly plan fee.
For the latest Voice+Data 5G product, the cited suspension page says the Vacation Plan is not available.
The exact non-payment suspension-to-termination grace duration is not stated in the cited official pages.
mobal-japan-voice-data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Keep the current 1GB Voice+Data 5G plan active at ¥1,650 per calendar month for this specific route.
mobal-japan-voice-data.safest_documented_action: Keep the monthly plan active with valid billing details and verify payment; if leaving Mobal but keeping the number, complete the documented number-porting path before termination.

minimum_expected_cost.note: This is route-specific and does not substitute the cheaper Voice Lite product, which is a different route.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the automatic payment date on the 8th.

mobal-japan-voice-data.grace_or_rescue_window: Unknown. Mobal warns failed billing can lead to suspension or termination but the reviewed official pages do not publish a fixed grace duration for this route.
mobal-japan-voice-data.termination_and_recycling: A submitted termination permanently disconnects service and loses the Mobal phone number. Once fully terminated, the plan cannot be reactivated and a replacement SIM/eSIM receives a new number. Exact recycling timing is not published in the cited pages.

reminder.description: Mobal posts the long-term invoice on the 1st and automatically charges the stored payment method on the 8th. This recurring reminder falls on the 5th, three days before the documented charge date.

sakura-japan-voice-data.inactivity_window: This is a monthly contract, not an inactivity-based prepaid line. A Voice+Data line can be placed on Sakura’s suspension option to keep the number while service is paused.
sakura-japan-voice-data.clock_start_or_reset: Normal service follows monthly billing. Suspension is applied for full calendar months through My Page according to the plan-change schedule.
qualifying_activity: Continue paying the normal Voice+Data monthly plan.
For number retention without service, use the documented Voice+Data suspension option at ¥220/month with credit-card payment.
If moving carriers, request MNP before submitting termination.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Suspension provides no calls, SMS or data, so it preserves the number but does not provide OTP continuity.
If the ¥220 suspension fee is unpaid, Sakura states the contract will be terminated.
After submitting termination, a plan change or MNP request can no longer be submitted.
sakura-japan-voice-data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Use Sakura’s Voice+Data suspension option at ¥220 per month if you only need to retain the current number and do not need calls/SMS/data during suspension.
sakura-japan-voice-data.safest_documented_action: If ongoing OTP/SMS access matters, keep the normal Voice+Data plan active. If you only need future ownership, use the official suspension option and keep the credit card valid.

minimum_expected_cost.note: Credit-card payment is required; suspended service has no call/SMS/data access.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before Sakura’s normal 25th-of-month plan-change/termination cutoff.

sakura-japan-voice-data.grace_or_rescue_window: No fixed unpaid grace period was found in the reviewed official pages. The suspension article says an unpaid suspension fee terminates the contract.
sakura-japan-voice-data.termination_and_recycling: Termination occurs at month-end according to the request cutoff. Users who want to keep the number should request MNP before termination; Sakura says an MNP request can no longer be submitted after a termination request. Exact post-termination recycling timing is not documented in the cited pages.

sources.label: Sakura Mobile — suspend Voice+Data and keep the number

reminder.reason: No single verified keep-alive deadline can be generated safely for this monthly route. The documented 25th-of-month cutoff is for plan changes/termination, not a universal payment-expiry deadline.

china-official-carrier.inactivity_window: Unknown at this generic route level. China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom plans must be verified separately.
china-official-carrier.clock_start_or_reset: Unknown until a specific carrier and plan are selected.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Do not generalize one recharge, inactivity or suspension rule across the three national operators.
china-official-carrier.safest_documented_action: Keep the selected carrier plan active under that carrier’s current terms; verify the exact plan before relying on the number long term.

reminder.reason: Choose a specific Chinese carrier and plan first. This generic route intentionally has no inferred inactivity or recharge deadline.

local-carrier.inactivity_window: Destination- and carrier-specific; no generic retention deadline is asserted.
local-carrier.clock_start_or_reset: Unknown until a specific carrier and prepaid plan are selected.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Top-up, outgoing use, incoming SMS, app login and balance checks must not be assumed to reset the clock without carrier evidence.
local-carrier.lowest_cost_documented_action: Unknown until a specific carrier is selected.
local-carrier.safest_documented_action: Verify the exact carrier’s inactivity and top-up terms before using the number for long-term recovery.
local-carrier.grace_or_rescue_window: Unknown until a specific carrier is selected.
local-carrier.termination_and_recycling: Unknown until a specific carrier is selected.
